Germany / Berchtesgaden

Kempinski Hotel Berchtesgaden

A thousand metres up, looking out over the Berchtesgaden Alps. A hotel for families who want more from winter than downhill skiing: on the days off the slopes, the hotel's Activity Team arranges the outings.

Enquire about this hotelAbout Berchtesgaden
01 / 03

In short

What to know.

  • The local winter sports school plans your lessons with you in the hotel lobby: skiing, snowboarding, cross-country and snowshoeing, with full days in the neighbouring Austrian ski areas
  • Cross-country trails a five-minute drive away, and the 2.3 km natural toboggan run at Hochschwarzeck, reached by chairlift
  • In summer: e-bike tours to Lake Königssee, golf, and walks to mountain huts

Why we send guests here

Who it suits.

For families who want a week with variety: a morning of lessons, an afternoon on the toboggan run, and a hotel that organises the rest.

Activities arranged by the hotel.

On the days off the slopes, the hotel's Activity Team arranges the outings.

The activities are run by the hotel and by the local providers it works with.

Good to know.

EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The stay and its activities are provided by Kempinski Hotel Berchtesgaden, under the hotel's terms.
